note: Public corrections log. Newest first. Rendered into corrections.html by scripts/render_corrections.py (run by prerender.yml) and shown on each corrected matter's panel (js/main.js). Add an entry whenever a published fact is changed because it was wrong, a matter is removed, or a published figure or label was misleading. Outcome updates that follow a case forward are not corrections and do not go here. Never edit or delete an old entry except to fix the entry itself.

entries.subject: Soros Fund Management v. Eretz Group (224 West 57th Street Foreclosure & Tenant-Takeover)
entries.was: The NYSCEF docket link was removed on September 24.
entries.now: Restored. The link is NYSCEF's case search with the index number (850134/2024) in its label, the form our docket-link rule allows because NYSCEF has no per-case link. Removing it was our error.

entries.subject: Duplicate of MLP Ventures v. Upper Merion Township (Renaissance Park Data Center Denial Appeal)
entries.was: The same September 16 filing was listed twice, from the same news article.
entries.now: The duplicate is removed. Two matters may no longer share a source article or a court docket; our publishing check now rejects it.
entries.basis: Same filing and source as the remaining entry

entries.subject: Landlords' Article 78 challenge to New York City's rent freeze on rent-stabilized apartments
entries.was: Listed as a tracked matter.
entries.now: Removed. It is a residential rent-regulation dispute, and CREdocket covers commercial real estate only.

entries.subject: Homepage and coverage page state count
entries.was: "51 states" with tracked matters, counting the District of Columbia as a state.
entries.now: "50 states and D.C." D.C. is counted and labeled separately everywhere a state count appears.

entries.subject: Homepage top story
entries.was: Two stories carried a "Today's Top Story" badge, and both concerned events months old.
entries.now: One featured story at a time, never about an event more than 30 days old, and labeled "Today's" only when it was added that day.

entries.subject: Access Point Financial, LLC v. Everhardt (Eve-of-Foreclosure Transfer and Bankruptcy Trigger Full Recourse Under Hotel Loan Guaranty)
entries.was: The guarantor was described as liable for $56.3 million, and the ruling as resting on the ownership transfer.
entries.now: The judgment is $3,954,244.04, the deficiency left on a $56.33 million loan after foreclosure sales, and the Eleventh Circuit rested on the borrower's bankruptcy filing alone.

entries.subject: 57th & 6th Ground LLC v. Carnegie House Tenants Corp. (Ground-Rent Arbitration Award Vacated for Arbitrator Non-Disclosure)
entries.was: The umpire's undisclosed conflict was described as a job offer.
entries.now: The umpire had undisclosed contact with the landowner's counsel about a paid appointment in another arbitration; the matter was remanded to a new panel. The document link now points to the Appellate Division decision. The same item in CREdocket Briefs Issue 1 was corrected to match.

entries.subject: Wells Fargo Bank, N.A. v. 181 West Madison Property LLC ($240M Loan Foreclosure on Chicago Loop Office Tower)
entries.was: Titled as a SitusAMC foreclosure suit filed in April 2026.
entries.now: The plaintiff is Wells Fargo Bank, N.A., as trustee of the CMBS trust, acting through special servicer Situs Holdings, LLC; the suit was filed March 27, 2026.

entries.subject: U.S. Bank National Association v. BOP Republic Plaza I LLC (Denver's Tallest Tower Receivership Suit)
entries.was: The borrower was named as Brookfield Republic Plaza LLC.
entries.now: The borrower is BOP Republic Plaza I LLC, a Brookfield Properties affiliate.

entries.subject: Stewart v. Simon Property Group, L.P. (Greenwood Park Mall Shooting Negligent-Security Suit)
entries.was: The security contractor was named as Allied Universal Event Services, Inc.
entries.now: The security contractor is Universal Protection Service, LLC, d/b/a Allied Universal Security Services.

entries.subject: OKO Group Affiliate v. Zurich American Insurance Co. et al. (Missoni Baia Builder's-Risk Coverage Suit)
entries.was: One insurer was named as National Fire Insurance Company of Hartford.
entries.now: The insurer is National Fire & Marine Insurance Company.

entries.subject: Town of Marshfield v. Commonwealth (SJC Rejects Second Municipal Challenge to MBTA Communities Act)
entries.was: The plaintiffs were described as Marshfield and eight other municipalities, with an infrastructure-strain claim.
entries.now: The plaintiffs were the Town of Marshfield and its select board only. The claims were unfunded-mandate, Home Rule Amendment, Zoning Act and voters' constitutional rights, and the court held the town lacked standing to assert its town meeting voters' rights.

entries.subject: United States, et al. v. LivCor, LLC (RealPage Algorithmic Pricing Antitrust Consent Judgment)
entries.was: A single final consent judgment was dated June 18, 2026.
entries.now: Two judgments: the Justice Department's on May 19, 2026 and the nine states' consent judgment on June 26, 2026. The states' filed judgment is now linked.

entries.subject: Ready Capital Mortgage Financing 2023-FL 12, LLC v. Drexel Flats Acquisition LLC (Oklahoma City Apartment Foreclosure)
entries.was: The source link pointed to an earlier article about the foreclosure filing.
entries.now: The source link reports the May 20, 2026 receivership ruling the entry describes.

entries.subject: U.S. Bank National Association v. Black Plaza Management, LLC (CPLR 3215(c) abandonment ruling)
entries.was: Listed as a commercial mortgage foreclosure.
entries.now: Removed. Its source never shows a commercial mortgage, so it did not meet the commercial-only scope rule.

entries.subject: Fourteen matters outside commercial real estate
entries.was: Listed as tracked matters: eight residential tenant-rights and habitability suits, three residential landlords' rent-cap and eviction-moratorium takings claims, a homeowners' pied-à-terre tax suit, a 1-4 unit investor loan-fraud case and a coal-mining penalty case.
entries.now: All removed. CREdocket covers commercial real estate only; borderline matters are left out.

entries.subject: Duplicate of Hern v. Alexandria Real Estate Equities, Inc. (Securities Class Action Dismissed Over $2.2B Impairment Claims)
entries.was: The same ruling was listed twice.
entries.now: The duplicate is removed; this entry carries the September 8 ruling.

entries.subject: Alder at Lake Park, LLC v. Town of Lake Park (Affordable Housing Code-Enforcement Extortion Suit)
entries.was: The suit was listed twice, and this entry's date was wrong.
entries.now: The duplicate is removed, its timeline and property type are merged here, and the filing date is August 27, 2026.

entries.subject: Copper Property CTL Pass Through Trust v. Onyx Partners (Countersuit Over Collapsed $947M JCPenney Portfolio Sale)
entries.was: Jurisdiction given as the Supreme Court of the State of New York, New York County, the court of an earlier related suit.
entries.now: The countersuit was filed in the Superior Court of Massachusetts, Suffolk County (Business Litigation Session, No. 2684CV02549-BLS1). The filed complaint is now linked.

entries.subject: ADA Risk Flagging tool, Colorado
entries.was: Stated that Colorado's HB21-1110 created a compliance safe harbor for businesses.
entries.now: Removed. HB21-1110 covers state and local government digital services, not private businesses, and creates liability rather than a safe harbor. The tool now says no Colorado overlay was confirmed.
